decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the requested two-row, four-badges-per-row layout. The badge-set decision requires no additional layout update.
The candidate requires permanent badges to be visible but does not define the badge names or count. Changing the approved badge set leaves this metadata requirement valid unchanged.
The approved badge composition does not affect NFT cover rendering, ebook linking, or the View Book controls.
The About page mentions badges and leaderboards only generically and does not enumerate Legend, First Mint, First Referral, or the badge count.
The FAQ describes referral-milestone badges generically and does not state the approved badge set or include the removed Legend badge.
The Mission page's generic reference to badges, leaderboards, and achievements remains accurate without naming or counting individual badges.
The badge-set change does not alter the rule that the dashboard must show only successfully minted NFTs.
Changing badge names and the badge count does not change prize-ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, transfer, or reset behavior.
The approved badge set has no effect on secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or royalty-funded prize destinations.
The landing-page hero state contains no badge-set names or counts and remains valid unchanged.
The badge-set decision does not alter the mint price or allocation among the founder, affiliate, and prize pool.

The source Event changes badge composition only. Other clauses in the same message about invalid referrals and the first-mint edge case are not part of this source Event and cannot be propagated from it.
